paraphrase: Bhadrabāhu, at Ujjayinī, heard a child cry 'go, go' and knew that a twelve-year famine was coming; he sent the saṅgha south under Viśākhācārya to the Punnāṭa country and himself ended his life nearby; the monks who stayed in Sindhu took to a half-cloth (ardhaphālaka), from which, in time, came the Śvetāmbaras and others.
notes: Story number and details low confidence; differs from the Śravaṇabeḷagoḷa account in the place of Bhadrabāhu's death.
